Synopsis:
Fed Governor Waller is signaling a pause in the rate-hiking cycle, advocating to "give disinflation a chance" and dampening expectations for a September hike. Markets are pivoting attention to the August jobs report as the next key data catalyst. Separately, record-high diesel prices are flagged as a lingering upside inflation risk heading into winter, creating a potential tension between the dovish rate signal and persistent cost pressures.
